senses.gloss: €1P. (हलति, हलित) To plough.

हलः,
हलम् 
__1 A plough. 
__2 A weapon. 3 A land-measure.

[हलो अस्त्यस्य अण्, हल एव वा अण्] 
__1 A plough. 
__2 N. of Balarāma. 
__3 N. of a king, Śālivāhana king. 
__4 A kind of bird. 
-ला Spirituous liquor. 
-ली A wife's younger sister. 
-Comp. 
-मृत् m. an epithet of Balarāma.

[हल् घञर्थे करणे क] 
__1 A plough; वहसि वपुषि विशदे वसनं जलदाभम् । हलहतिभीतिमिलितयमुनाभम्; or हलं कलयते [[Gīt. 1.]] 
__2 Deformity, ugliness; ततो मया रूपगुणैरहल्या स्त्री विनिर्मिता । हलं नामेह वैरूप्यं हल्यं तत्प्रभवं भवेत् ॥ [[Rām. 7. 30. 22.]] 
__3 Hindrance. 
__4 Quarrel. 
-Comp. 
-अभः a piebald horse. 
-आयुधः 
__1 an epithet of Balarāma. 
__2 N. of the author of अभिधान-रत्नमाला. 
-ककुद् f. the projecting beam of a plough. 
-गोलकः a kind of insect; फलं वा मूलकं हृत्वा अपूपं वा पिपीलिकाः । चोरयित्वा च निष्पावं जायते हलगोलकः ॥ [[Mb. 13. 111. 100]] (com. हलगोलकः दीर्धपुच्छो गोलरूपी कीटविशेषः). 
-दण्डः the shaft or pole of a plough. 
-धर, -भृत् m. 
__1 a ploughman. 
__2 N. of Balarāma; केशव धृतहलधररूप जय जगदीश हरे [[Gīt. 1]]; अंसन्यस्ते सति हलमृतो मेचके वाससीव [[Me. 61.]] 
-भूतिः, -भृतिः f. ploughing, agriculture, husbandry. 
-मार्गः a furrow. 
-मुखम् a ploughshare. 
-वाहा a particular land-measure. 
-सीरः a ploughshare. 
-हति f. 
__1 striking or drawing along with a plough. 
__2 ploughing.

हलदी,
हलदीका, हलद्दी f. Turmeric.
a. Ploughing, making furrows.
An exclamation of applause or approbation.
Eagerness; [[Hch. 8.]]

__1 A female friend. 
__2 The earth. 
__3 Water. 
__4 Spirituous liquor. -ind. A vocative particle used in addressing a female friend; (only in theatrical language); हला शकुन्तले अत्रैव तावन्मुहूर्तं तिष्ठ [[Ś. 1]]; cf. हण्डा also.

__1 A large plough. 
__2 A furrow. 
__3 Agriculture.
A ploughman.

[हलेन खनति हलः प्रहरणमस्य तस्येदं वा ठक् ठञ् वा] 
__1 A ploughman, an agriculturist; कस्मिश्चिंदधिष्ठाने हालिकदपम्ती प्रतिवसतः स्म [[Pt. 4. 92̭93.]] 
__2 One that draws a plough (as a plough-ox). 
__3 One who fights with a plough. -a. Relating or belonging to a plough; [[P. IV. 3. 124.]]

m. 
__1 A ploughman, an agriculturist. 
__2 Balarāma. 
-Comp. 
-प्रियः the Kadamba tree. 
(-या) spirituous liquor.
A number of ploughs.
A kind of large house-lizard.
The teak tree.

हलीषा,
हलेषा The handle of a plough.

a. 
__1 Arable, to be ploughed. 
__2 Ugly, deformed. 
-ल्यम् 
__1 A ploughed field. 
__2 Deformity, ugliness; [[Rām. 7. 30. 22]]; see हलम् (2).
A number of ploughs.
A spotted or variegated horse, a piebald horse.

हलाहलः,
हलाहलम् 
__1 = हाल (ला) हल. 
__2 A kind of snake. 
__3 A sort of lizard. 
__4 A kind of deadly poison; see हाल (ला) हलम्.

__1 A kind of insect. 
__2 A kind of lizard. 
-ला A small mouse. 
-ली Spirituous liquor. 
-लम् 
__1 = हालहल (1). 
__2 Spirituous liquor.
A kind of horse.
The red lotus.
Rolling or tossing about (as in sleep).

(-षम्) 
__1 One of the 18 Uparūpakas or minor dramatic compositions; (described as a piece in one act and consisting mainly of singing and dancing by one male and seven, eight or ten female performers; see [[S. D. 555.]] 
__2 A kind of circular dance).

हल्लीश(स)कः
Dancing in a ring; घोषवासस्यानुरूपोऽयं हल्लीसकनृत्तबन्धं उपयुज्यताम् [[Bālacharitam 3]]; हल्लसिकं सललितं रुचिरं वहामि ibid. 4. 6.
A horse of a yellowish-brown colour.

हाल(ला)हलम्
 
__1 A sort of deadly poison produced at the churning of the ocean; (being of a very virulent character it began to burn up everything when it was swallowed by the god Śiva); अहमेव गुरुः सुदारुणानामिति हालाहल मास्म तात दृप्यः । ननु सन्ति भवाद्दशानि भूयो भुवनेऽस्मिन् वचनानि दुर्जनानाम् [[Subhāṣ.]]; हालाहलं न विषं विषं रमा [[Subhāṣ.]] 
__2 (Hence) A deadly poison or poison in general; हालाहलं खलु पिपासति कौतुकेन [[Bv. 1. 95]]; 2. 73; मधु तिष्ठति वाचि योषितां हृदये हालहलं महद्विषम् [[Pt. 1. 188.]] (Also written हलाहल or हालहाल).

हालहली,
हाला Wine, spirituous liquor; हित्वा हालामभिमतरसां रेवतीलोचनाङ्काम् [[Me. 51]]; [[Pt. 1. 58]]; [[Śi. 10. 21]]; हालया साकमज्ञातं हालाहलमदापयत् [[Śiva B. 28. 21.]]
A wife's younger sister.
A tooth.
